name: Sukkur
registryBasis: Board of Revenue, Government of Sindh operates the Sindh Zameen land-record portal and Sukkur service-center/digitization functions. Its official Sukkur dashboard documents a Board of Revenue digital scanning unit and indexed registration documents; the active-center page lists Sukkur among district centers. Portal FAQs state that record search is owner-name keyed and deliberately limited for privacy, and ruled cards contain ownership/transaction details. These sources confirm local land-record and registration services, not anonymous full parcel geometry or citywide coverage.

officialSources.observation: Sindh Zameen is the official Board of Revenue Government of Sindh portal for land records, registries, Deh maps, property registers and ruled cards; it contains owner-name and CNIC search controls. No query was submitted.

Official portal FAQ says record search is available to persons whose names are entered in the record, provides only limited information for privacy, and notes Village Form II urban property registers plus rural agricultural forms. It does not promise city parcel vectors.
Official active-centers page lists a Sukkur district service center.

Official Board of Revenue Sukkur dashboard describes a local digital scanning unit, 11 sub-registrar offices across three districts, and registration documents indexed (aggregate administrative metrics). This confirms local registration activity, not open geometry.

The official Ruled Card service describes surveyed property cards with ownership and subsequent transaction details for 20 Sindh cities; the interface asks District, Taluka/Town, Ward/Quarter and Survey number. It was not used because it exposes property-level records, not safe geometry-only data.
The official Deh Map host returned 502 on the public route during review; the Sindh BOR geodatabase page did not expose an anonymous feature service schema. No query or sample was made.
